title: Document and harden sync refresh exit semantics for partial success
description: bwrk sync refresh can rebuild ledgers and search successfully, return JSON with top-level ok true, and still exit 1 when the nested sync status is unhealthy because protected-branch collaboration paths are dirty. Agents interpret this inconsistently.
acceptanceCriteria: sync refresh JSON clearly separates refresh success from final health failure and includes a stable machine-readable reason for nonzero exit.
CLI docs explain the exit-code contract and the fields agents should inspect.
Regression tests cover successful artifact refresh plus failing git health without ambiguity.
closedReason: Sync refresh partial-success semantics are documented and covered by protected-branch regression tests.
